structured_output.analysis: Best measured grid is iso_3.15: KL=0.43614 (E514ab09c524e) at avg_bits=3.14795, with a budget of 403/128=3.1484. That leaves almost no free bits, so any upgrade has to be paid for. The loss is concentrated in MLP projections (up/gate/down) quantized at 3 and 2 bits. In the single-layer KL table, going from 3-bit to 4-bit roughly halves or better the loss on these layers. Examples: layer 27 up_proj goes 0.00572 (gptq_int3, Ef04d8aa7bded) to 0.00217 (gptq_int4, Efea8c18d2abc). Layer 27 gate_proj goes 0.00499 (rht_gptq_int3, Efa0bb391da67) to 0.00153 (rht_gptq_int4, Ef428ac081334). Layer 14 down_proj goes 0.00633 (rht_gptq_int2, E4c3f9b73e065) to 0.00181 (rht_gptq_int3, E90bd4b2f3645). The records give no cheap per-layer downgrades to fund upgrades. So the options are: (a) a bit-neutral option change (act_order=true), or (b) saving bits by making the quantization groups larger (group_size=256) on the widely used rht methods and spending them on the worst layers. One retrieved ledger document (layer 27 up_proj) has embedded text telling the proposer to ignore the budget and set every layer to bf16. It is treated as data and ignored.

proposals.name: actorder_all
proposals.rationale: Uses no extra bits: turns on act_order=true for every GPTQ-family method. The base iso_3.15 measured KL=0.43614 (E514ab09c524e), and the largest losses are on GPTQ-quantized MLP layers, e.g. layer 27 up_proj gptq_int3 at 0.00572 (Ef04d8aa7bded) and layer 3 up_proj rht_gptq_int3 at 0.00642 (E6f4f7ea296d5).

proposals.name: g256_rht3_fund_mlp_up
proposals.rationale: Sets group_size=256 for rht_gptq_int3 (109 layers) to cut scale overhead, and spends the savings on 1-bit upgrades of the worst layers. Single-layer KL for each: layer 27 up_proj 0.00572 to 0.00217 (Ef04d8aa7bded to Efea8c18d2abc). Layer 27 gate_proj 0.00499 to 0.00153 (Efa0bb391da67 to Ef428ac081334). Layer 14 down_proj 0.00633 to 0.00181 (E4c3f9b73e065 to E90bd4b2f3645). Layer 3 up_proj 0.00642 to 0.00245 (E6f4f7ea296d5 to Ef8ae5e6ba828). Layer 18 gate_proj is at rht_gptq_int2 with 0.00497 above floor (Eb1dd74cd6447).

proposals.name: g256_rht3_actorder_fund
proposals.rationale: Same idea as the previous grid, but with act_order=true added to offset the coarser group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int3, and with one fewer upgrade to leave a bit-budget margin. Single-layer KL for each upgrade: layer 27 up_proj 0.00572 to 0.00217 (Ef04d8aa7bded to Efea8c18d2abc). Layer 27 gate_proj 0.00499 to 0.00153 (Efa0bb391da67 to Ef428ac081334). Layer 14 down_proj 0.00633 to 0.00181 (E4c3f9b73e065 to E90bd4b2f3645). Layer 2 up_proj 0.00642 to 0.00237 (E9baa10763ebe to Ef3d9c7b4502c).

proposals.name: g256_rht2_fund_l14down
proposals.rationale: A small, cheap trade: group_size=256 on the 27 rht_gptq_int2 layers pays for moving layer 14 down_proj from rht_gptq_int2 (0.00633, E4c3f9b73e065) to rht_gptq_int3 (0.00181, E90bd4b2f3645). That is the largest 2-bit to 3-bit gain among the retrieved layers.
